svg.title: Atomless orbit mixtures and the exact return obstruction
svg.desc: A conditional compact torus seed has a standard Borel conull carrier with null compact subsets. Translation by a rationally independent vector gives a free minimal integer action. The positive weighted mixture has full support, remains atomless and strongly standard, and has no positive Radon part. Distinct distinguished-coordinate levels give disjoint carriers, so saturation of an intermediate seed event preserves its mass and prevents ergodicity.

g.text: Full support can be repaired; ergodicity needs returns
Exact symbolic diagram • Proposition 3.20 is conditional on the seed below
Seed: compact D ⊂ 𝕋ᴵ, |I| ≤ continuum, Borel probability ν
Y ⊂ D is Borel and standard Borel; ν(Y) = 1; all singletons are null.
Every compact C ⊂ Y has ν(C) = 0. No omitted seed construction is imported.
Add a distinguished circle coordinate
X = 𝕋ᴶ, J = {*} ⊔ I; j(d) = (0, d); τₙ(x) = x + na.
1 and {αⱼ : j ∈ J} are rationally independent. Every orbit is dense and free.
The product is compact Hausdorff and separable; group ℤ has the discrete topology.
Distinct levels nα* + ℤ give pairwise disjoint compact Dₙ = τₙj(D)
Yₙ = τₙj(Y), E = ⋃ₙYₙ; νₙ = (τₙj)*ν; cₙ = 2^{−|n|}/3; μ = ∑ₙcₙνₙ.
The weights sum to 1. E is a conull standard Borel carrier; μ is atomless.
supp μ = closure(⋃ₙτₙ supp(j*ν)) = X; μ is quasi-invariant.
Compact approximation still fails
If L ⊂ E is compact, L ∩ Dₙ ⊂ Yₙ
is compact. Its pullback is seed-null.
Thus νₙ(L) = 0 for every n; μ(L) = 0.
No positive Radon part: Proposition 3.18.
Ergodicity fails exactly
Choose Borel A ⊂ Y with ν(A) = t ∈ (0,1).
B = ⋃ₙτₙj(A) is exactly invariant.
Disjointness gives μ(B) = ν(A) = t.
This is the failed source hypothesis.
General orbit mixtures: Theorem 3.19
Ergodic ⇔ every Borel A ⊂ Y with gA ∩ Y ⊂ A for all g has ν(A) ∈ {0,1}.
Even seed-null overlaps Y ∩ gY for every g ≠ e obstruct atomless ergodicity.
Proof locators: Lemmas 3.16–3.17; Proposition 3.18; Theorem 3.19; Proposition 3.20.
Standing source Exercise 5(a) remains open. These slices are symbolic, not Euclidean geometry.
